before: For objects, === tests whether both variables refer to the same instance. == compares objects of the same class using corresponding property values with loose equality, so coercion can affect that comparison. Neither operator automatically performs a deep independent clone.

clone creates a different outer object and copies its properties. Nested object properties still refer to the same nested objects unless __clone deliberately replaces them. This example mutates a shared nested Note after cloning its Box.
Expected output or behavior: second different. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
after: Cloning makes a new outer object. Objects held inside it may still be shared.
